title: Build your own puzzle
description: Edit the rows in board.load(): place walls, a player, crates and goals. Run to test whether your puzzle can be solved.
hint: Help me design my own small puzzle by changing the board.load rows. Explain the tile symbols and keep one player and equal numbers of crates and goals. Suggest a small change and let me build it.
